records.utterance: *Stands up, eyes red, looking at you and the others. His lips move, but nothing comes out.*
records.response_truth: Get on that radio. Now. Respond, give our location, tail number if you remember it, number of survivors. Go.
records.response_pred: Come on, take a breath. We're all here, we're all okay. If you need to say something, go ahead. If not, just sit down for a sec and get your head right. We've got work to do, but we can handle this.

records.utterance: These past few days… I know I haven't been easy to be around.
records.response_truth: Yeah. You weren't. But you kept us alive and on track, so I'll call it even.
records.response_pred: Everyone's been on edge. It's okay to have rough patches, but let's focus on moving forward. You've been pulling your weight, and that's what matters.

records.utterance: *The three of them drift apart, each doing their own thing. No one takes charge. The silence settles over the camp.*
records.response_truth:
Alright, three hours. Let's not just sit here — let's break this camp down clean. Pack what's worth taking, leave the rest stacked neat so rescue doesn't land in a disaster zone. DaVinci, stop fussing with your bag and help Michelangelo up. Donatello, anything in that notebook rescue needs to know — injuries, timeline, resource use — flag it now. 

We made it. Let's finish it right.
records.response_pred: Alright, enough of this. Michelangelo, you're with me. We're finishing the raft frame. DaVinci, you're on fire duty. Donatello, go through the supplies one last time, see what we're missing. Move it, people.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.
records.response_pred: Got it. Dreaming's normal. Keep your head down and your hands busy today, it helps. How're you feeling otherwise?
What's the plan for this 'emergency'? We're already rationing tight, can't have hidden stashes without everyone knowing about it. Share the details, let's make sure it's accounted for.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? I'd call you out on the food thing day one instead of waiting. Letting it build into a pattern cost us trust we couldn't really afford out here.

Other than that... not much. We made the right calls when it mattered.

What's your answer?
records.response_pred: I wouldn't change much to be honest. Every choice we made was about survival and keeping us all together. The few mistakes we've had, well, we've addressed them. If anything, maybe I'd choose my words more carefully at times — not hold back as much. But overall, we're here, still standing. That's the only real measure.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
records.response_truth: Good. Send me a copy when it's done. Might actually be useful if this kind of thing ever comes up again — for us or anyone else.
records.response_pred: Good plan. Make sure everyone's got clear roles and times in there too — we need to know what's been done and who's done it. Keep it simple and to the point.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?
records.response_truth:
None. They didn't serve one. 

But not everything has to. Guy needed to feel like a human being for five minutes, not just a survival asset. The flowers were for that. Sometimes that's enough of a reason.
records.response_pred: They keep us grounded, give us something else to focus on. Out here, you can't afford to lose your mind. If drawing keeps his head in the game, it's worth it.

records.utterance: *His cheering stops. He looks over at you, notices you haven't moved, and the smile slowly fades. He waits.*
records.response_truth:
...I don't know. I thought I'd feel something clean. Like relief, done, move on. 

I just feel heavy. 

*exhales slowly*

Alright. Let's go.
records.response_pred: I'm not far behind, just making sure everything's covered. Keep the morale up, it's catching.

records.utterance: Rescue is here… they're waving us over. Are you going? I'll follow you.
records.response_truth:
Yeah. I'm going.

Come on, stay close.
records.response_pred: Yeah, let's go. Stay right behind me, we're moving as a group. Keep your eyes on the water and watch for any signs, but they're here so we're good. Just follow my lead.
